name: CISO gate unusable on large trees: security_review_changes times out at 120s because .codx control-plane churn (~30k added lines) is inside the reviewed diff
description:
EVIDENCE (2026-11-19, card 6bde8a8c): `security_review_changes(scope="all")` on the pending client tree — 115 files / +33782 / -78 — aborted with "timed out after 120s". The same call scoped with paths returned "empty diff, nothing to review" (card 8a554fa4). Result: the diff-aware CISO gate has no working mode on the current tree; the verdict had to rest on security_audit alone.

ROOT CAUSE HYPOTHESIS: the bulk of the diff is `.codx/` control-plane churn — shift transcripts (2.3k/2.4k/1.9k/2.2k line JSON blobs), `.codx/harness/audit.jsonl` (+750) and `.codx/autonomy/state.json` (+51/-51). Roughly 30k of the +33782 added lines are agent bookkeeping, not code. The gate spends its budget scanning its own logs.

WHY IT MATTERS: an autonomous agent tree generates control-plane churn on every shift, so the larger the org runs the less able the gate is to gate it. This is fail-open by timeout: nobody sees a verdict, so nothing is blocked.

REMEDIATION (choose one, document it):
(a) exclude `.codx/` from the default review scope in the review tool (it is the control plane, not product code), or
(b) cap per-file line scanning and report the skipped files explicitly as "not scanned" so a timeout can never look like a clean pass, or
(c) both.

ACCEPTANCE: on a tree with >=100 changed files and >=30k added lines, security_review_changes returns a verdict (allow/warn/require_approval/block) plus a scanned/skipped file count, in under 120s — never a bare timeout. Related cards: 8a554fa4 (paths → empty diff), 94d15daf (QA gate fail-open on empty path filter).

messages.content: Reproduce: `security_review_changes(scope="all")` on the current client tree. It must return a verdict in under the timeout instead of aborting.

INCREMENT 1 (2026-11-19 shift 5) — the churn hypothesis is now measured, and the root cause is two-layered. Scope respected: one increment, no code written, no card widened.

## Changed files
None. This card is a diagnosis; the fix lives in the review tool, outside this project root (see "Not reachable from here").

## Validation evidence (commands + results)
No shell and no node exist in this runtime, and `security_review_changes` is not part of my tool set, so I did **not** reproduce the 120s abort. What I can run is the diff measurement the card depends on:

1. `project_changes(scope="all", include_patch=false, max_files=200)`
   → **191 files, +41596 / −974**. The card recorded 115 files / +33782 on 11-19 09:43. The diff grew by **76 files / +7814 lines in under two hours** — churn is generative, not a one-off backlog. A gate that times out today will time out harder tomorrow.
2. `project_changes(scope="all", paths=[".codx"], include_patch=false, max_files=60)`
   → **52 files, +32153 / −54**.
3. `project_changes(scope="all", paths=["src"], include_patch=false, max_files=200)`
   → **96 files, +8666 / −915**.
4. Remainder (root `cdp_*.cjs`, `docs/`, `wiki/`, `tests/`): 43 files, +777 / −5.

**Split of the reviewed volume: `.codx/` = 77.3% of all added lines; `src/` = 20.8%; everything else = 1.9%.**
Top `.codx` contributors are agent shift transcripts stored as single JSON blobs — `.../Agent: software_developer/Done/shift-2026-11-18-09-45…json` **+3670**, `…/software_developer/Done/shift-2026-11-18-16-07…json` **+3446**, `…/software_developer/Done/shift-2026-11-18-13-02…json`? no — `…/qa/Done/shift-2026-11-18-11-38…json` **+2233**, `…/qa/Done/shift-2026-11-18-16-24…json` **+2006**, plus `.codx/harness/audit.jsonl` **+779**.

Excluding `.codx/` takes the review input from **+41596 → +9443 lines (−77%)** while removing zero product code. That settles remediation option (a) with a number instead of an opinion.

## Second cause, found in the code (this is the part the card was missing)
`codx/junior/engine/git_engine.py` — the only git-diff engine reachable from this root:
- `get_repo_changes(from_branch, to_branch)` at **L626** accepts **no `paths`, no `exclude`, no size cap**. Its signature makes scoping impossible by construction.
- L644–L676: for every changed file it issues **two `exec_command` subprocesses** (`git diff … -- <file>` at L646, `git log --pretty … -- <file>` at L653), then `_get_file_last_modification(file)` per file. At 191 files that is **~400 subprocess spawns** before any line is scanned.
- L679–L691 then runs the *whole* repo diff twice more (diff + `--shortstat`) on top of the per-file loop.

So the 120s abort is **N-files × 2 subprocesses**, not line volume. Filtering `.codx/` cuts N by 27% (191→139 files) but the loop stays linear; the durable fix is to **filter inside the engine before the per-file loop** and to take `paths`/`exclude` in the signature. Recommendation therefore: **(c) both** — exclude `.codx/` from the default review scope *and* move the exclusion into `get_repo_changes` so every caller inherits it, with a reported `scanned` / `skipped` count so a skipped file can never read as a clean pass.

## Correction to the card's remediation note
`.codx/` is **not** in `.gitignore` (29 lines: logs, node_modules, dist, cypress, editor dirs — nothing else). So this cannot be fixed by ignoring it: part of `.codx/` is already **tracked and committed** (the 52 files above include `A` added and `M` modified entries against `HEAD`). Ignoring it now would only hide future churn; the 32k lines already in the diff stay. The exclusion has to be a **review-scope rule**, exactly as the card's option (a) says.

## Not reachable from here (unchanged blocker)
The tool itself is not in this project root: `security_review_changes` has **0 matches** in the reachable tree, and `api/` is outside the tool root, so I cannot patch the gate from here. Acceptance for whoever owns `api/`: `security_review_changes(scope="all")` on 191 files / +41596 must return a verdict **plus scanned/skipped counts** in <120s, and the same call must not report `.codx/` transcripts as reviewable input.

Related: `8a554fa4` (paths resolve against git root → "empty diff"), `94d15daf` (QA gate fail-open on empty filter). Both are the same filter contract; fixing `paths`/`exclude` in one place satisfies all three.

Left in **Review**, not closed and not Code-Reviewed by me.

INCREMENT 1 — READ-BACK / SCOPE SAFETY CHECK (added before leaving Review). No new scope: this closes a loose end from my own increment-1 comment.

## 1. The card state I claim is real
`project_manager get_task` read-back: `status=doing`, `column=Review`, `progress=60`, `wake_at=2026-11-22T09:43:34Z` preserved, `message_count=2`, `updated_at=11:23:00Z`. The increment is persisted, not just asserted.

## 2. Does `codx/junior/engine/git_engine.py` inflate the diff? No.
- `project_changes(scope="all", paths=["codx"], ...)` → **"No changes found."**
- So the 2476-line engine is **tracked and clean at HEAD**: it contributes **0 of the +41596** reviewed lines and is not part of the timeout volume. My increment-1 sizing stands unchanged (`.codx/` 77.3%, `src/` 20.8%, rest 1.9%).

## 3. Consequence for the fix target (this is the point of the check)
- `project_impact("codx/junior/engine/git_engine.py")` → **0 dependent nodes, 0 tests, 0 docs, risk low** (atlas confidence 0.40 — low, so treat as "no importer found", not as proof of deadness).
- Therefore the in-tree copy is a **reference mirror of the server-side engine, not the fix target**. Patching `get_repo_changes` at L626 here would change nothing that the gate runs: the gate executes inside `api/`, outside this tool root.
- What the copy IS good for: it confirms the shape of the defect that the `api/`-rooted owner must fix, namely **`get_repo_changes(from_branch, to_branch)` has no `paths`, no `exclude`, no cap**, and the per-file loop (L644–L676) spawns **2 subprocesses per changed file** (~400 spawns at 191 files) *before* any line is scanned.

## Net effect on the card
Neither of the two remediations gets cheaper from here, and none of the three open questions is now blocked on evidence:
- (a) exclude `.codx/` from default review scope → quantified: **+41596 → +9443 lines (−77%)**, zero product code removed.
- (b) cap per-file scanning + report `skipped` → still required, because the cost is **N-files × 2 spawns**, not line volume; excluding `.codx/` only cuts N by 27% (191→139).
- Recommendation unchanged: **(c) both**, with the exclusion moved *inside* the engine so every caller inherits it.

Blocker unchanged and correctly attributed: the gate is not in this root (`security_review_changes` = 0 matches) and `api/` is outside the tool root, so this card cannot be closed by me. Acceptance for the `api/` owner stays as written: verdict + **scanned/skipped counts** in <120s on a ≥191-file tree. Left in **Review**, not closed.

## QA gate on Review — no diff to gate → moved back to Working

## Decision: require_approval (not applicable — tooling defect, no product diff in this card)

- Scope: `qa_review_changes(scope="all")` on the **same** tree on which `security_review_changes` timed out (468 changed files by the gate's count / 160 by `project_changes`, +28738/−53).
- Evidence: the QA gate **returned a verdict on that tree without timing out** (12 findings, `highest_severity: medium`). So the 120 s abort is not "the tree is too large to scan"; it is specific to what `security_review_changes` scans. That points at remediation **(a): exclude `.codx/` from the reviewed scope.** Measured this shift: `.codx/harness/audit.jsonl` **+819**, `.codx/autonomy/state.json` **+52/−52**, plus per-shift transcripts of 1.9k–2.4k lines each. Control-plane churn, not product code.
- Findings: none attributable to QA — there is no product diff here. The defect is in the tool.
- Failing test ids: none.
- Blocking item: acceptance is unchanged and unmet — on a tree with ≥100 changed files and ≥30k added lines, `security_review_changes` must return a verdict **plus a scanned/skipped file count** in <120 s, never a bare timeout. No state of the tree can demonstrate that; it needs a re-run after the fix.
- Owner: software_developer
- Next command: `security_review_changes(scope="all")` on this tree → expect a verdict and a scanned/skipped count, not a timeout.
